notes.title: Major update is now live
notes.content:
Major update is now live.
The game is now easier . We fixed the time interval to the random colour changes so now you don't need to have godly reflexes ;) 
Be warned the game is still very challenging but now is 100% fair.
We fixed some minor bugs, and some performance issues to some low spec pc's.
We also fixed some bugs in the 3 infinite modes and the time intervals to the random colour changes.

notes.title: Major Balancing update coming soon
notes.content: Into the TIMEverse is back again. Soon we will update the game by releasing a major balancing patch for the entire game. Details will be announced when the patch released.
